snippet_primary: "I was charged $259.64 by Domestika without ever subscribing to anything. I only bought two individual courses, and suddenly I'm being billed for a subscription I never signed up for. I have reached out multiple times, and all I get are automated replies—there's no customer service, no phone number, no human reply."
